tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
for d in 01 02 03 04 05; do printf 'x' > "$t/dest/demo-202601$d-000000.tar.gz"; (cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "demo-202601$d-000000.tar.gz" > "demo-202601$d-000000.tar.gz.sha256"); done
echo '--- keep=3 (expect oldest 2 deleted, newest 3 kept):'
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=3
ls "$t/dest" | grep -c tar.gz
echo '--- dry-run keep=2 (deletes nothing):'
bash rotate.sh --quiet -n --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2
echo '--- verify --name filter + malformed sidecar + missing archive:'
printf 'deadbeef  gone.tar.gz\n' > "$t/dest/other.sha256"
printf 'garbage\n' > "$t/dest/broken.sha256"
rc=0; out=$(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo) || rc=$?; echo "out=[$out] rc=$rc"
rc=0; out=$(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest") || rc=$?; echo "out=[$out] rc=$rc"
echo '--- --help exits 0, unknown flag exits 1:'
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "bogus rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0 2>/dev/null; echo "keep0 rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manually exercise refactored rotate/verify edge cases
